summary.text: Hillary Pham is a Republican candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 4-Position 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Air Force veteran who served from 2018 to 2023, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she later worked as a legislative assistant to Rob Chase.

paragraphs.text: Hillary Pham earned a high school diploma from Stanwood High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Washington in 2018.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was born in Everett, Washington, grew up in Stanwood, and earned a Bachelor of Arts in urban planning.
Pham served in the U.S. Air Force from 2018 to 2023, and said in the survey that she was a captain at Fairchild Air Force Base in Spokane County.
She said she then served as an intergovernmental affairs officer at the Spokane County office and as a legislative assistant for Rob Chase.
Her stated campaign priorities were defending public safety, education empowerment, and economic opportunities.
